title: Fugue
summary: FUGUE, noun [Latin fuga.] In music, a chase or succession in the parts; that which expresses the capital thought or sentiment of the piece, in causing it to pass successively and alternately from one

inlines.v: FUGUE, noun [Latin fuga.] In music, a chase or succession in the parts; that which expresses the capital thought or sentiment of the piece, in causing it to pass successively and alternately from one part to another.
